blind.description: A small mortar and pestle made of weathered stone or ceramic. The mortar is a rounded, footed bowl with a thick rim, and a matching pestle rests inside it, angled diagonally with its handle extending over the rim. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with natural mottled beige/grey stone textures, standing directly on its base on the floor.
blind.from_above: A circular bowl opening containing a diagonal pestle extending slightly over one edge, casting a shadow to the upper-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 5 to 6 inches tall and wide, about 1/12th the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure.
